bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDX has three independent native issuance chains: Ethereum, Flare, and Songbird. The Ethereum and Flare V2 deployments also expose a LayerZero OFT burn/mint route with reciprocal peers. Their local delivery contracts, peers, Endpoint addresses, and issuer EOA configuration/upgrade controllers are identified, while direct MINTER_ROLE issuance and native UUPS mint-logic controls remain in Mint Authority. The exact current per-OApp DVN/executor roster, quorum, and validator controller are not established by the reviewed sources, so external validation authority remains unresolved. Songbird V1 has no callable OFT surface and remains native-only.

protocols.name: LayerZero V2 OFT
protocols.note: Ethereum and Flare USDX V2 deployments expose OFT burn/mint and reciprocal peers; Songbird V1 does not expose a callable OFT surface.

routes.protocol: Hex Trust native issuance / LayerZero V2 OFT
routes.reviewNote: USDX is independently issuer-minted natively on ethereum, and the same V2 deployment is a LayerZero OFT route. At Ethereum block 25771176 on 2026-08-16, the proxy resolved to implementation 0xce2d107b6046e61a651484b4ee65023d89a42d7b with endpoint() = LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, token() = address(this), msgInspector() = 0, preCrime() = 0, and peers(30295) = Flare USDX 0x4a771cc1a39fdd8aa08b8ea51f7fd412e73b3d2b. The verified HexTrustUSDV2 _debit path burns source balances and _credit path mints destination balances. The direct MINTER_ROLE native issuance path remains in Mint Authority; this route's OFT bridge capabilities, peer/configuration, upgrade, and external validation domains are assessed here.

USDX is independently issuer-minted natively on songbird. At Songbird block 130516710 on 2026-08-16, the proxy resolved to implementation 0xf34a47df7098a23f42a06839f0cc2ea61caafb0b; current V1 reads expose no callable OFT endpoint(), token(), msgInspector(), preCrime(), or peers(uint32) surface (the calls reverted). No LayerZero bridge controls are attributed to Songbird; direct MINTER_ROLE and native UUPS mint-logic controls remain in Mint Authority.

controls.label: USDX Ethereum LayerZero OFT default-admin EOA

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Ethereum block 25771176, peers(30295) returned Flare USDX 0x4a771cc1a39fdd8aa08b8ea51f7fd412e73b3d2b. LayerZero EID 30295 is Flare mainnet, so the configured peer binds this OFT route to the reviewed Flare deployment.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: HexTrustUSDV2._debit burns the source sender balance and _credit mints the destination balance. Route supply conservation depends on LayerZero message validation and reciprocal peer configuration; this is bridge accounting, not independent native mint authority.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25771176, defaultAdmin() resolved to 0xb8ce31ad8bad26e88db17e68f695c64f67ad31eb and the EOA held UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE. The verified V2 source authorizes OFT peer/configuration and UUPS upgrade paths through the default-admin or upgrade-admin role; native MINTER_ROLE grant/revoke authority remains separately reviewed in Mint Authority.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771176 on 2026-08-16, the USDX proxy's defaultAdmin() returned 0xb8ce31ad8bad26e88db17e68f695c64f67ad31eb, the EIP-1967 implementation was 0xce2d107b6046e61a651484b4ee65023d89a42d7b, endpoint() returned 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, peers(30295) returned the Flare USDX deployment, and the OFT source exposed burn-on-debit and mint-on-credit. This preserves the Ethereum route's LayerZero bridge and upgrade risk without treating the same EOA's native MINTER_ROLE administration as bridge authority.

controls.label: USDX Ethereum-Flare LayerZero V2 validation domain

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero V2 endpoint/DVN/executor validation is an external route failure domain. The exact per-OApp DVN and executor configuration, validator membership, quorum, and emergency override roster were not read; no threshold or custody claim is made.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: LayerZero's reviewed Ethereum and Flare deployment records identify EIDs 30101 and 30295, while fixed-block reads confirmed reciprocal USDX peers between those EIDs.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: Endpoint deployment addresses and reciprocal OApp peers do not identify the current USDX-specific DVN/executor roster, quorum, or validator controller.

controls.evidence: The Ethereum and Flare USDX V2 deployments use the identified LayerZero V2 Endpoint contracts and reciprocal OFT peers, so their delivery path is known. The 2026-08-28 review found no primary source in the record that resolves the current USDX-specific DVN/executor roster, quorum, emergency override roster, or controlling authority. A generic Endpoint contract type cannot stand in for those missing validator facts; this validation control therefore remains unknown. Reclassified 2026-09-01 under AUTHORITY-LADDER 9.46: the controlling party for this control is the external LayerZero V2 DVN/executor validation quorum itself, a rotating protocol-scoped operator set with no single controllerAddress to record. Its authority model is therefore validator-quorum, known but weak, graded no higher than a named issuer backend and never above a named multisig, rather than unknown. The unresolved roster, quorum, override and peer facts recorded above are unchanged; only the authority classification moved.
